strengths: Clear differentiated mechanism: synthetic dollar backed by trading positions, not fiat reserves.
Credibility signals are prominent: audits, security firms, attestation, and custody partners.
Strong product narrative for accessible institutional yield, including low minimums and DeFi composability.
Tori Finance has 0.0% unprompted recall in brand-free category queries, while the platforms above own the visible share of voice.
